decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot was launched only in 2023 and extends the firm's core automation line. Its uncertainty is still high and keeping it costs little, so the option should stay open.

The automatic de-shuttering robot is a modular building block of the automated circulation system that shares engineering with the other robots. A single year of evidence does not justify abandoning it.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots in an integrated cell. Its marginal carrying cost is low and its value is still unresolved, so the firm keeps the option.
The automatic shuttering robot fits the firm's strategic push toward automated precast production. With the industry growing and results not yet revealed, keeping it preserves upside at little cost.
